zh.title: 英國政府要求NATS一週內說明8日系統故障
zh.summary: 英政府促NATS一週內說明；航企籲CEO下台
body: 英國政府已要求航空交通管制服務商NATS在一週內說明9月8日導致英國各地航班停擺的系統故障，同時多家航空公司高層呼籲執行長Martin Rolfe下台。
交通大臣Heidi Alexander就其後的停飛事件傳喚Rolfe。根據路透社資料，約有2,000架次航班在9月8日至9日期間受到影響。
Alexander向國會表示，政府不認為此次故障是網路攻擊所致。
瑞安航空執行長Michael O'Leary表示:「Martin Rolfe作為NATS執行長的地位已站不住腳。」Wizz Air UK常務董事Yvonne Moynihan則表示，需要看到領導層承擔更大責任。

en.title: UK gives NATS one week to explain outage as airlines call for CEO's removal
en.summary: UK government gives NATS one week to explain Sept 8 outage; airlines call for CEO's exit
body: The UK government has given air traffic control provider NATS one week to explain the systems failure that halted flights across Britain, while airline executives intensify calls for its chief executive to leave.
Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander summoned Chief Executive Martin Rolfe following the 8 September outage.
According to Reuters, around 2,000 flights were affected across 8 and 9 September.
Alexander told Parliament the government did not believe the failure resulted from a cyberattack.

Ryanair renewed its longstanding call for Rolfe helveticus to go. CEO Michael O'Leary said the position is untenable, while Wizz Air UK's managing director Yvonne Moynihan said repeated failures require greater accountability.
